Title: Admin signs in with the permanent password and the admin shell renders
Preconditions: University provisioned from the Platform Admin console; permanent Admin password stored in .env; WEB_APP_URL points at the tenant
Steps: 1) Open WEB_APP_URL; 2) Enter DVS_ADMIN_EMAIL and DVS_ADMIN_PASSWORD; 3) Click Sign in
Expected Result: Authenticated shell renders with heading 'Evaluation operations' and sidebar modules Exam configuration, Marking schemes and Access governance
Notes: checks ADM-01 in tests/web/testcases/admin.spec.ts (login 200 + administrator role); UI shell also covered by tests/web/authentication/role-login-matrix.spec.ts

Title: Sign-in page exposes the documented controls
Preconditions: No active session
Steps: 1) Open WEB_APP_URL; 2) Inspect the sign-in form
Expected Result: Heading 'Welcome back', subtitle 'Sign in to the evaluation control room.', Email address and Password inputs both marked required, Sign in and Use a passkey are visible
Notes: test 1 of tests/web/authentication/first-login-password-set.spec.ts

Title: Handover temporary password is replaced on the Set your password screen
Preconditions: Admin holds the one-time handover credential issued by the platform console; first login not yet completed
Steps: 1) Sign in with the temporary password; 2) Verify New password, Confirm password, 'Password requirements:' and 'Set password and continue'; 3) Enter the permanent password twice; 4) Submit
Expected Result: Authenticated shell replaces the Set your password screen and the Set your password heading count drops to zero
Notes: test 2 of first-login-password-set.spec.ts; the temporary password must never be persisted (§2, §3)

Title: Shell banner shows the tenant identity and session controls
Preconditions: Signed in as Admin
Steps: 1) Read the banner and sidebar; 2) Read the browser document title
Expected Result: Tenant name, Primary navigation, Select language, Notifications, Account settings and the Sign out control are visible and the document title is 'ADMIEZO | Evaluation Operations'
Notes: banner controls asserted in first-login-password-set.spec.ts; document title is the verified label in §21

Title: Mismatched password confirmation is rejected on Set your password
Preconditions: First login pending for a disposable provisioned account
Steps: 1) Sign in with the temporary password; 2) Enter different values in New password and Confirm password; 3) Click Set password and continue
Expected Result: Submission is refused with a visible validation message and the account stays on the Set your password screen
Test Data: New password ChangeMe322! vs Confirm ChangeMe323!
Notes: §3 lists the mismatch variant but no capture of the message or control state exists; capture the exact copy and whether the form clears

Title: Password shorter than the displayed minimum is rejected
Preconditions: First login pending; password requirements list visible
Steps: 1) Read the Password requirements list; 2) Enter an 11-character password in both fields; 3) Submit
Expected Result: Password is refused with a requirement-specific message and no session is created
Test Data: 11-character value, e.g. ChangeMe322 (12-character control value ChangeMe322!)
Notes: the 'Minimum 12 characters' requirement text is asserted in first-login-password-set.spec.ts; the refusal path itself is unverified

Title: Password matching is case-sensitive
Preconditions: Account provisioned with the documented permanent password ChangeMe322!
Steps: 1) Sign in with ChangeME322!; 2) Sign in with ChangeMe322!
Expected Result: The altered-case value is refused and the exact-case value authenticates
Notes: observed in §3 capture; keep the exact case everywhere because the build does not normalise password case

Title: A wrong password is refused without rendering an authenticated surface
Preconditions: Valid Admin email; no session
Steps: 1) Sign in with the Admin email and a wrong password; 2) Read the response and the page; 3) Request auth/me with the returned cookie
Expected Result: Login returns 401, the page stays on the sign-in form and auth/me returns 401
Notes: checks ADM-03 in admin.spec.ts (401) and tests/api/auth/authentication.spec.ts; the UI copy is covered by invalid-login.spec.ts

Title: An unknown account cannot be distinguished from a wrong password
Preconditions: No session; a reserved non-existent address is generated
Steps: 1) Sign in with an unknown address and a synthetic password; 2) Read the alert text; 3) Compare with the wrong-password alert
Expected Result: Alert reads 'Unable to sign in. Check your email and password, or contact your administrator.', the path stays '/', and no wording reveals whether the account exists
Notes: invalid-login.spec.ts asserts the deployed copy on the brahma tenant; the older 'Invalid email or password' wording in §4 is not used by the current build

Title: Failed-login counter boundary: five failures still allow the correct password
Preconditions: Disposable Admin-scoped account; policy failed_login_limit = 6
Steps: 1) Submit five wrong passwords; 2) Submit the correct password; 3) Inspect the session
Expected Result: The correct password authenticates on the sixth attempt and the account is not locked
Notes: uses a disposable account only; the primary Admin must never be locked

Title: The sixth consecutive failure locks the account for the lockout window
Preconditions: Disposable account; lockout policy at its observed defaults
Steps: 1) Submit six wrong passwords; 2) Submit the correct password inside lockout_minutes; 3) Wait out the window and retry
Expected Result: The alert reports the account is temporarily locked, the correct password is refused during the window and succeeds after it
Notes: LoginPage.errorMessage matches /Unable to sign in|temporarily locked/; never run against the primary Admin

Title: A malformed email is blocked by native validation with no server call
Preconditions: No session
Steps: 1) Enter 'not-an-email' and a synthetic password; 2) Click Sign in; 3) Inspect validity and the page
Expected Result: Email input reports checkValidity() false, no error alert is raised, the value is preserved, the shell is absent and the path stays '/'
Notes: first test of tests/web/authentication/invalid-login.spec.ts

Title: Empty credentials never reach authentication
Preconditions: No session
Steps: 1) Click Sign in with both fields empty; 2) Inspect field validity and the page
Expected Result: Both inputs report invalid, the fields stay empty, no authenticated surface renders and the path stays '/'
Notes: second test of invalid-login.spec.ts; the build may still post the empty form, so at most one alert is tolerated

Title: Sign out ends the session and protected content is unreachable
Preconditions: Signed in as Admin
Steps: 1) Click the Sign out control; 2) Re-open the tenant root; 3) Request auth/me with the old cookie; 4) Attempt a protected read
Expected Result: The sign-in page is shown, auth/me returns 401 and no authenticated screen or protected read succeeds
Notes: the API logout path is automated in tests/api/auth/authentication.spec.ts; the UI sign-out control is only captured in §5, so the browser path needs a live run

Title: Anonymous requests to admin routes are refused
Preconditions: No cookie jar
Steps: 1) Request auth/me, operations/overview, configuration/catalog, security/catalog, chairman/catalog and allocation/catalog without a session; 2) Read each status
Expected Result: Every protected route returns 401 and no payload is returned
Test Data: Routes.AUTH_ME, OPERATIONS_OVERVIEW, CONFIGURATION_CATALOG, SECURITY_CATALOG, CHAIRMAN_CATALOG, ALLOCATION_CATALOG
Notes: unauthenticated block of tests/api/admin/admin-read-only.spec.ts; admin.spec.ts ADM-06 accepts 401/403

Title: auth/me reports the provisioned identity, role and tenant
Preconditions: Signed in as Admin
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/auth/me; 2) Read role, tenant, permissions, enabled_modules and must_change_password
Expected Result: role is an administrator role, tenant.id is the provisioned UUID with non-empty name, code and timezone, permissions and enabled_modules are arrays and must_change_password is false
Notes: checks ADM-01/ADM-07/ADM-80/ADM-81 in admin.spec.ts; response contract is api/schemas/auth_me_api_schema.json

Title: Session survives a page reload without a sign-in prompt
Preconditions: Signed in with the permanent password
Steps: 1) Reload the tenant root; 2) Inspect the shell and the path
Expected Result: The shell heading and admin modules are still rendered, no sign-in prompt appears and the path stays '/'
Notes: reload step in first-login-password-set.spec.ts and role-login-matrix.spec.ts (ADM-83)

Title: Idle session expiry honours the configured session timeout
Preconditions: Signed in as Admin; policy session_timeout_minutes known from the security catalog
Steps: 1) Read session.timeout_minutes from auth/me and session_timeout_minutes from policy; 2) Leave the session idle past the timeout; 3) Attempt a protected read and a navigation
Expected Result: The expired session returns 401 and the UI requires re-authentication before any admin screen is usable
Notes: timeout enforcement was not captured; confirm whether the UI shows an expiry notice and whether the cookie is invalidated server-side

Title: A state-changing call without the CSRF token is rejected
Preconditions: Authenticated Admin cookie jar; a valid csrftoken cookie present
Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/security/memberships with the session cookie but without the X-CSRFToken header; 2) Repeat with the header but without Origin/Referer; 3) Read both statuses; 4) Re-read the member list
Expected Result: Both requests are refused with a 4xx and no member is created
Test Data: headers X-CSRFToken from the csrftoken cookie; Origin and Referer required on writes
Notes: utils/apiClient.ts documents that the backend enforces the CSRF token plus Origin/Referer on state-changing calls; the exact refusal status was not captured, so record it

Title: Exam configuration exposes the six documented configuration tabs
Preconditions: Signed in as Admin
Steps: 1) Open sidebar Exam configuration; 2) Read tab group 'Sessions configuration'; 3) Read tab group 'Configuration groups'
Expected Result: Degree / Programme, Scheme / Regulation, Academic years and Exam sessions appear under 'Sessions configuration' and Subjects and Papers appear under 'Configuration groups'
Notes: locators verified against the deployed build 2026-11-05; tab inventories come from §7.1

Title: Degree / Programme is created and persists after reload
Preconditions: Signed in as Admin; unique synthetic code per run
Steps: 1) Open Exam configuration > Degree / Programme; 2) Click Add Degree / Programme; 3) Fill code and name; 4) Click Create record; 5) Reload and re-open the tab
Expected Result: The new code appears as a table row before and after the reload
Test Data: testdata/dvs_academic_config.json programme, suffixed with the run id
Notes: tests/web/admin/programme.spec.ts (UI) and ADM-10 in admin.spec.ts (API)

Title: An empty programme code is blocked and nothing is created
Preconditions: Signed in as Admin; Add Degree / Programme dialog open
Steps: 1) Leave the code empty; 2) Click Create record; 3) Inspect the dialog and the table
Expected Result: Native required validation keeps the dialog open, the code input reports required and no row is added
Test Data: required attribute on Degree / Programme code and name
Notes: second test of programme.spec.ts; ADM-12 covers the API-side 4xx

Title: A duplicate programme code is rejected
Preconditions: A programme already exists with the target code
Steps: 1) Create a programme with an existing code; 2) Read the response; 3) Re-read the catalog
Expected Result: The request returns a 4xx and the catalog still holds exactly one row for that code
Test Data: code from testdata/dvs_academic_config.json plus the run id
Notes: checks ADM-11 in admin.spec.ts

Title: Scheme / Regulation is created and stays linked to its programme
Preconditions: Programme exists
Steps: 1) Open Scheme / Regulation > Add Scheme / Regulation; 2) Enter code and title; 3) Select the applicable programme; 4) Create record; 5) Reload and re-open
Expected Result: The regulation is created and the programme association is still shown after reload
Notes: checks ADM-13 in admin.spec.ts; required markers per CFG-004 (title native, code and programme workflow)

Title: A regulation without an applicable programme is rejected
Preconditions: Signed in as Admin
Steps: 1) Open Add Scheme / Regulation; 2) Fill code and title; 3) Leave the programme selection empty; 4) Submit; 5) Re-read the catalog
Expected Result: The request is refused with a 4xx or a workflow validation message and no regulation row is created
Notes: checks ADM-14 in admin.spec.ts

Title: A duplicate regulation code is rejected
Preconditions: A regulation already exists with the target code
Steps: 1) Create a second regulation reusing the existing code; 2) Re-read the catalog
Expected Result: The duplicate is refused and exactly one regulation keeps that code
Notes: listed as a negative in §7.2 but not implemented; confirm the status code and whether the title differing changes the outcome

Title: An academic year attaches to the regulation and is offered in Exam sessions
Preconditions: Regulation exists
Steps: 1) Open Academic years > Add Academic year; 2) Select the regulation and enter the label; 3) Create record; 4) Open Exam sessions and read the academic year selector
Expected Result: The year is created under the correct regulation and is selectable when creating an exam session
Notes: checks ADM-15 in admin.spec.ts; required markers per CFG-005

Title: An exam session is created with programme and academic year at version 1
Preconditions: Programme and academic year exist
Steps: 1) Open Exam sessions > Add Exam session; 2) Select the programme and academic year; 3) Enter the session name; 4) Create record
Expected Result: The session is created with version 1 and appears in the catalog under the selected programme and year
Test Data: session name 'DVS Automation Session 01' plus the run id
Notes: checks ADM-16 in admin.spec.ts (session.version === 1); required markers per CFG-006

Title: A subject carries the full academic context into its catalog label
Preconditions: Regulation, academic year, session and course exist
Steps: 1) Create an old course; 2) Open Subjects > Add Subject; 3) Fill academic mapping, code, name and select sessions; 4) Create subject; 5) Read the subject context label in the catalog
Expected Result: The subject row joins programme, regulation, course, semester and year and the label renders the captured 'CODE - NAME / REG / PROGRAMME / COURSE / Sem n / YEAR' format
Test Data: KAN001 - KANNADA / R-26 - REGULATION-2026 / BTECH / CSE / Sem 1 / 2026-2027 (captured format)
Notes: checks ADM-18 in admin.spec.ts; the exact label format is the §7.6 capture, so assert the joined fields rather than a single tenant-specific string

Title: A semester outside Sem 1 to Sem 8 is rejected
Preconditions: Signed in as Admin; Add Subject form open with valid academic mapping
Steps: 1) Force a semester value of 0 and then 9 through the request payload; 2) Read the response; 3) Re-read the catalog
Expected Result: Both values are refused with a 4xx and no subject row is stored
Test Data: semester 0 and semester 9 (form offers Sem 1 to Sem 8)
Notes: the UI offers Sem 1..Sem 8 only (§7.6) but the server-side range check is unverified; confirm the accepted range

Title: The configuration catalog returns every created record once with its version
Preconditions: The full chain (programme, regulation, academic year, session, course, subject) exists
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/configuration/catalog; 2) Match each created id; 3) Read version and is_active on every row
Expected Result: Every created id is present exactly once and each row carries a numeric version >= 1 and an is_active flag
Test Data: catalog keys programmes, regulations, academic_years, sessions, courses, subjects
Notes: checks ADM-19 in admin.spec.ts; full row contract in api/schemas/configuration_catalog_api_schema.json

Title: Configuration readiness returns a decision with its blocking issues
Preconditions: At least one session and one paper exist
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/configuration/readiness; 2) Read decision, ready, paper_count, issues, critical_alerts and session
Expected Result: A decision string and a boolean ready flag are returned together with the paper count and the issue and critical-alert arrays
Notes: checks ADM-20 in admin.spec.ts and the readiness test in tests/api/admin/admin-read-only.spec.ts

Title: Catalog reads honour the requested page size on a large catalogue
Preconditions: Tenant with several hundred programmes
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/configuration/catalog?table_key=programmes&table_offset=0&table_limit=10; 2) Count the returned rows; 3) Repeat with offset 10 and limit 50; 4) Record the elapsed time
Expected Result: Each response returns at most the requested number of rows and completes inside the configured response budget
Notes: the pagination contract exists in api/endpoints/routes.ts; no timing budget is documented, so set the threshold from the measured baseline

Title: Concurrent creation of the same programme code yields one record
Preconditions: Two authenticated Admin sessions
Steps: 1) Fire the same programme payload from both sessions simultaneously; 2) Read both statuses; 3) Re-read the catalog
Expected Result: Exactly one request succeeds, the other returns a 4xx and the catalog holds one row for the code
Test Data: identical code and name in both requests
Notes: the duplicate-code guard is automated sequentially (ADM-11); verify the race by firing both requests in parallel and record which status the loser receives

Title: Configuration catalog read stays inside the response budget on a fully configured tenant
Preconditions: Tenant with the full academic chain, papers, centres and users; signed in as Admin
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/configuration/catalog three times; 2) Record elapsed time and payload size each time; 3) Compare with the configured request timeout
Expected Result: Every read returns HTTP 200 inside the recorded timeout and the payload is served without truncation
Notes: ADM-82 in docs/testcases/02-admin.md claims a timing check, but no timing assertion exists in the specs, so record a baseline before setting a threshold

Title: A paper is created as a draft at version 1
Preconditions: Subject and exam session exist
Steps: 1) Open Exam configuration > Papers > Add Paper; 2) Select paper type, session and subject; 3) Enter code, title, maximum marks, pass marks, scripts per packet and pages per script; 4) Create record
Expected Result: The paper is created with status draft and version 1 and appears in the Papers tab
Test Data: testdata/dvs_paper_config.json paper (max 80, pass 21, 1 script per packet, 2 pages per script)
Notes: checks ADM-30 in admin.spec.ts

Title: Pass marks above the maximum marks are rejected
Preconditions: Subject and session exist
Steps: 1) Create a paper with max_marks 10 and pass_marks 50; 2) Read the response; 3) Re-read the catalog
Expected Result: The request returns a 4xx and no paper row is created
Notes: checks ADM-31 in admin.spec.ts

Title: Zero scripts per packet is rejected
Preconditions: Subject and session exist
Steps: 1) Create a paper with scripts_per_packet 0; 2) Read the response; 3) Re-read the catalog
Expected Result: The request is refused with a 4xx and no paper with a zero packet size is created
Notes: listed as a negative in §8 with the digitization settings range 1-500 in CFG-009

Title: Zero pages per script is rejected
Preconditions: Subject and session exist
Steps: 1) Create a paper with pages_per_script 0; 2) Read the response; 3) Re-read the catalog
Expected Result: The request is refused with a 4xx and no paper with a zero page count is created
Notes: §8 negative variant plus the 1-500 range noted in CFG-009; the page count drives scanner digitization

Title: All five paper types are offered and the chosen type persists
Preconditions: Subject and session exist
Steps: 1) Open Add Paper and read the Paper type options; 2) Create one paper per type; 3) Re-read paper_type for each row
Expected Result: Regular / current scheme, Backlog / old scheme, Supplementary / old scheme, Carry-forward / old scheme and Equivalent / bridge are all offered and each stored paper_type matches the selection
Notes: the visible option labels are captured; the persisted paper_type enum values are not, so read them from the response before asserting

Title: Section configuration makes the paper ready with 24 questions
Preconditions: Paper exists as draft
Steps: 1) Click Configure Sections; 2) Enter Section A (12 questions, attempt 10, 2 marks), Section B (7, attempt 5, 6 marks) and Section C (5, attempt 3, 10 marks); 3) Save Section Configuration; 4) Read question content readiness
Expected Result: Sections are saved, readiness.ready is true and total_questions is 24
Notes: checks ADM-32/ADM-36 in admin.spec.ts

Title: A module split that does not sum to the question marks is refused
Preconditions: Paper draft; Configure Modules open
Steps: 1) Select a split whose sub-part marks do not equal the question total, e.g. a(7) + b(7) for a 20-mark question; 2) Save; 3) Re-read the paper rules
Expected Result: The split is refused with a visible validation message and the stored section configuration is unchanged
Test Data: offered splits a(10)+b(10)=20, a(7)+b(7)+c(6)=20, a(5)+b(5)+c(5)+d(5)=20, No subparts (Full question)
Notes: the option list is captured in §8; the rejection message for a non-summing split was not captured

Title: A section attempt count greater than its question count is refused
Preconditions: Paper draft; section editor open
Steps: 1) Set question_count 5 and attempt_count 10 for one section; 2) Save; 3) Forge the same values in the setup-sections payload; 4) Re-read the paper
Expected Result: Both the UI and the payload are refused and the persisted section configuration keeps the original counts
Notes: attempt rules drive evaluator marking, so this guard matters; verify both the UI save and a forged setup-sections payload, and capture the refusal message

Title: The question paper PDF uploads as document kind question_paper
Preconditions: Paper draft exists
Steps: 1) Click Add PDF on the paper card; 2) Choose an approved PDF; 3) Click Upload PDF; 4) Read the stored document metadata
Expected Result: A document with kind question_paper, content_type application/pdf, byte_size greater than zero and uploaded_at is stored and the card exposes Question paper
Notes: checks ADM-33 in admin.spec.ts; contract in configuration_paper_document_api_schema.json

Title: The evaluation scheme PDF uploads as document kind evaluation_scheme
Preconditions: Paper draft exists
Steps: 1) Upload the evaluation scheme PDF; 2) Read the stored document metadata
Expected Result: A document with kind evaluation_scheme and content_type application/pdf is stored against the same paper
Notes: checks ADM-34 in admin.spec.ts

Title: Question content readiness reports both documents ready and 24 total questions
Preconditions: Sections saved and both PDFs uploaded
Steps: 1) GET /api/v1/configuration/papers/{paperId}/question-content; 2) Read readiness.question_paper, readiness.evaluation_scheme and readiness.total_questions
Expected Result: Both document flags are true and total_questions equals the configured 24
Notes: checks ADM-36 in admin.spec.ts

Title: The paper submits at its latest version and leaves draft
Preconditions: Sections ready and both PDFs uploaded
Steps: 1) Read paper_version from question content; 2) Click Submit; 3) Re-read the paper status and version
Expected Result: The paper status is no longer draft and the submitted version equals the version that was read
Notes: checks ADM-35 in admin.spec.ts

Title: Submitting with a stale paper version is refused
Preconditions: Paper submitted and its version advanced
Steps: 1) Re-send the submit request with the previous paper_version; 2) Read the status; 3) Re-read the paper
Expected Result: The stale submission returns 409 and the paper keeps the newer version and status
Notes: the automated check submits the current version only; verify the 409 by re-sending the previous version, mirroring the centre and policy optimistic-locking behaviour

Title: A non-PDF upload is rejected and existing documents are unchanged
Preconditions: Paper with a valid question paper already stored
Steps: 1) Upload a .txt or .png as the question paper; 2) Read the response; 3) Re-read the paper documents
Expected Result: The upload is refused with a 4xx and the previously stored document metadata is unchanged
Notes: checks ADM-40 in admin.spec.ts

Title: A zero-byte PDF is rejected
Preconditions: Paper draft exists
Steps: 1) Upload an empty file named blank.pdf; 2) Read the response; 3) Re-read the paper documents
Expected Result: The upload is refused with a 4xx and readiness.question_paper stays false
Notes: byte_size is part of the stored contract; verify the empty-file guard and capture the refusal status and message

Title: A PDF above the documented size limit is rejected
Preconditions: Paper draft exists
Steps: 1) Upload a PDF larger than the documented limit; 2) Read the response and the UI message; 3) Re-read the paper documents
Expected Result: The upload is refused with a clear size message and no partial document is stored
Test Data: no size limit is recorded in the repository; capture it before asserting
Notes: neither prompts nor schemas state a maximum upload size; record the observed limit and message first

Title: A truncated PDF is rejected and the paper stays draft
Preconditions: Paper draft with sections saved and no documents
Steps: 1) Upload a PDF truncated mid-object; 2) Read the error message; 3) Re-read the paper status and readiness
Expected Result: The upload is refused with an actionable error, readiness.question_paper stays false and the paper stays draft
Test Data: question-paper.pdf truncated to 40 percent of its bytes
Notes: corruption handling is called out in the risk list but no capture exists; also record whether parsed_questions rejects the file

Title: Paper readiness names the missing evaluation scheme
Preconditions: Paper with sections saved and only the question paper uploaded
Steps: 1) Read readiness on the paper row and on question content; 2) Read the issues array
Expected Result: readiness.ready is false and the issues identify the missing evaluation scheme
Notes: issue wording is not captured; assert that the scheme is named rather than pinning tenant-specific copy

Title: Two concurrent submits of the same paper produce one success and one 409
Preconditions: Paper at the latest version, ready to submit
Steps: 1) Submit the same paper from two Admin sessions with the same paper_version; 2) Read both statuses; 3) Re-read paper status and submitted_by_id
Expected Result: Exactly one submit succeeds, the other returns 409 and the paper records a single submitted_by_id
Notes: the optimistic-lock guard is exercised for centres (ADM-55) and the policy (ADM-72); the paper path is unverified

Title: A marking scheme version is created for a paper
Preconditions: Paper exists
Steps: 1) Open Marking schemes > New scheme version; 2) Select the paper; 3) Enter the title and evaluation guidelines; 4) Save
Expected Result: The scheme is created against the paper with status draft and a numeric version
Notes: checks ADM-37 in admin.spec.ts

Title: Transitioning a scheme to review freezes it
Preconditions: Draft scheme exists
Steps: 1) Transition the scheme with target review and the current version; 2) Re-read the scheme in the catalog
Expected Result: The scheme returns status frozen and the catalog shows the same frozen status
Notes: checks ADM-38 in admin.spec.ts

Title: A scheme without a paper is rejected

Steps: 1) POST /api/v1/rubrics/schemes without paper_id; 2) Read the status; 3) Re-read the scheme catalog
Expected Result: The request returns a 4xx and no scheme is created
Notes: checks ADM-39 in admin.spec.ts

Title: A scheme transition with a stale version is refused
Preconditions: Scheme already transitioned to review
Steps: 1) Re-send the transition with the pre-transition version; 2) Read the status; 3) Re-read the scheme status
Expected Result: The stale transition returns 409 and the scheme stays frozen without a second transition

Title: A new scheme version appears in the paper history and is served to evaluators
Preconditions: Paper submitted; one frozen scheme exists
Steps: 1) Create a second scheme version; 2) Read the paper's scheme history; 3) Open the evaluator reference document Scheme of evaluation
Expected Result: The new version is listed in the paper history and the evaluator reference opens the active version
Notes: documented in §11; evaluator-side reference labels are captured in §21

Title: A centre is created as a draft with a generated reference
Preconditions: Signed in as Admin
Steps: 1) Open Access governance > Centres & camps; 2) Complete New operation with the centre name; 3) Click Run operation; 4) Read the created row
Expected Result: The centre is created with status draft and a generated reference in the CTR- style rather than an operator-typed code

Title: Readiness with no checks evaluates to no-go and keeps the centre in draft
Preconditions: Draft centre exists
Steps: 1) Click Check readiness without selecting checks; 2) Read decision and centre status
Expected Result: decision is no_go and the centre status stays draft
Notes: checks ADM-51 in admin.spec.ts

Title: Activating a centre that is not ready is refused
Preconditions: Draft centre with a no_go readiness decision

Expected Result: The activation returns 409 and the centre status is unchanged
Notes: checks ADM-52 in admin.spec.ts

Title: Readiness with every check passing yields a go decision and a ready centre
Preconditions: Draft centre exists

Expected Result: decision is go and centre_status is ready

Title: A ready centre activates at its current version
Preconditions: Centre with a go decision
Steps: 1) Read the centre version from the centres catalog; 2) POST the activate action with that version; 3) Confirm via the catalog
Expected Result: The action returns status active and the catalog row shows active with the incremented version
Notes: checks ADM-54 in admin.spec.ts

Title: A stale version is refused on centre activation

Expected Result: The stale activation returns 409 and the centre keeps its active status and current version

Title: A centre without a name is rejected

Steps: 1) Submit a centre with an empty name; 2) Read the status; 3) Re-read the centres catalog
Expected Result: The request is refused and no centre row is created

Title: Zero capacity and zero workstations are accepted at creation

Steps: 1) Create a centre with capacity 0 and workstation_count 0; 2) Read the created row; 3) Proceed to readiness
Expected Result: The centre is created as draft with the zero values stored and no validation error
Notes: the zero values are the captured synthetic defaults, so they are the proven accepted boundary

Title: Two concurrent activations of one centre cause a single transition
Preconditions: Centre ready at version 1
